score.check_completion: satisfied required checks / all required checks * 100
score.note: Heuristic indicator only; not a probability or production release certification.

decision.NO-GO: Any critical open blocker or any required failed check.
decision.CONDITIONAL: Open blockers or evidence gaps remain.
decision.GO-TO-REVIEW: All required checks pass or are N/A, evidence is present, all blockers are closed, and scope context is complete.
